# anthropic_workspace_member (Data Source)

Reads one workspace membership. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_member" "example" {
  workspace_id = "wrkspc_01ExampleWorkspaceId000000"
  user_id      = "user_01ExampleUserId0000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User id (`user_...`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id (`wrkspc_...`).

### Read-Only

- `workspace_role` (String) Workspace role.
